purpose: y2s64-thumbstage: Nord2Metal only (y2s63 + probe + staging). In MobileSlideShow, before a two-plane YCbCr surface (format 500) is converted on the GPU, 16 luma bytes at its centre row are read by the CPU, through the in-place import's buffer object mapped back (bo) and by a GPU copy into a driver texture (gpu): 'SURF raw-check ... cpu= bo= gpu= -> the GPU sees the surface | does NOT see' (first 24). When the GPU does not see the bytes (run ph9: gpu=000000 vs cpu=cab5b0 for surfaces 91-93), the planes are copied (memcpy, no pixel arithmetic) into a '420f' CVPixelBuffer of this process (rows of 64, even size) and the GPU converts from that ('SURF ycbcr-stage ...'); off with /var/db/nord2-metal/no-ycbcr-stage. Pixel work stays on the GPU; the CPU conversion is only the last fallback. Backup Nord2Metal.pre-thumbstage; undo: guest-thumbstage-undo.sh (back to y2s63-vt23).
